desc: Read-only op-115 retest with the PCIe-PLL bring-up m1n1 omitted (ticket 058 decode). m1n1 e4671e08 adds the exact _configPciePLLs clkgen(reg[6]) sequence before PHY-IP: set32(clkgen+0x4,0x80000000); mask32(clkgen+0x0,0x7,0x1); poll clkgen+0x0 bit31 clear (PLL lock). ADT-derived base, offsets/values from paired AppleT6040PCIe, no invented addresses. Existing op-115 read-only stop unchanged: the only new reg[3] access is one read of 0x417040090. Exact hashes are pinned from done/2026-07-23-t6040-pcie-op115-clkgen-pll-preflight.md. Plan approval is recorded; still requires current rig recovery and independent exact cross-review before one boot. Pass = read returns instead of hanging; stop on SError/watchdog/nonzero L2C.
